title: Boggan households after the Shattering
summary: How boggans held on as freeholds faded.

claims.text: As balefires and freeholds faded, scattered fae and changelings drew together around the few that remained; those cut off in dead stretches of the Autumn World by closing trods could only band together and hunker down.

Households whose sidhe stayed, or who kept faith without them, fortified what balefires they had and ran things as before; those abandoned by their leaders, or disgusted by them, gathered instead in motleys.
